title: A Table, Unclaimed
lessons: a third place can be yours without a transaction

text: The corner table is empty because everyone assumes it belongs to someone else.
You sit down with your book and an hour that has not been assigned.
Around you, people rehearse their busyness.

choices.text: Read until the room disappears around the page.
Close the book and people-watch without inventing their lives.

text: A chapter ends. Nothing pings to congratulate you.
The room becomes a room again: cups, coats, bad posture, weather.
